items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: I only know of one drummer who likes playing on cymbals he’s never played on before. He’s a great drummer, a great musician, Joey Baron.

ctx.x: Unless you have that ball peen hammer.

Right. I only know of one drummer who likes playing on cymbals he’s never played on before. He’s a great drummer, a great musician, Joey Baron. Joey welcomes it because he says, “Every time I play on a different kit with different cymbals it forces me to play in a © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-
different way. And man I just like — wow. Yes. Definitely. So you know there’s a positive side to everything.
